newsitem.title: USA: Key Energy sets Hitwell Surveys acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Key Energy sets Hitwell Surveys acquisition.

text.p: Key Energy Group Inc said its WellTech Eastern Inc subsidiary signed a letter of intent to acquire Hitwell Surveys Inc of Parkersburg, W.Va.
WellTech, which operates in the Appalachian Basin and Michigan, will acquire eight well logging and perforated trucks plus ancillary equipment for about $1.3 million.

Key also said it completed the acquisition of Woodward Well Services Inc in Woodward, Okla. The acquisition added five well service units, fishing tools and ancillary equipment, at a cost of $719,000.
